detail: Generic endpoint cap dropped all critical earnings/analyst families.
catalog smoke_priority orders fundamentals 1-6 and earnings/analyst 90-94 (last).
with --max-endpoints 6 the six critical families were never attempted.
build_probe_queue() always front-loads critical families by rank (earnings/analyst rank 0-5) ahead of fundamentals/profile (rank 10+).
the endpoint-family cap trims ONLY the non-critical tail; if cap < #critical the cap is overridden so no critical family is dropped.
the request budget is respected by dropping non-critical families only.
critical-first bounded queue actually used this run (cap=12).
